_comment: What the workshop takes in and what it turns away, plus the shape of the drop-off slot picker. Structural data only — the page's wording lives in copy.json, the same split as brands.json.
_excludedComment: Confirmed by the client 2026-09-16. Shown on the first step, in plain sight, so somebody with a broken dishwasher finds out in five seconds rather than after filling in a form.
_slotsComment: Drop-off is any day the shop is open — the days and times come from `hours` in site.json, never retyped here. `middayHour` is only where the day is cut in two for the morning/afternoon choice. `daysAhead` is how far the calendar's month navigation reaches, not a booking horizon: nothing is reserved, so there is no real cost to letting a customer plan several months out — a customer travelling and dropping the item off once they are back needs to be able to pick a month ahead, not just a fortnight. Widened from 14 to 180 on 2026-09-16 for exactly that case.
